---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement to the platform
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Requested By**
Internal team / Client name / Both

**System Area**
Which area(s) are involved?
- [ ] Player Portal / Public Website
- [ ] Admin / Back Office
- [ ] Payments (DD, card, recurring)
- [ ] Draw Engine / Results
- [ ] Communications (email, SMS, push)
- [ ] Reporting / Exports
- [ ] Integrations (payment gateway, third-party API)
- [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->

**Problem Statement**
What problem does this solve or what opportunity does it address?

**Proposed Solution**
Describe the desired behaviour clearly.

**Alternatives Considered**
Any alternative approaches or workarounds evaluated.

**Behaviour Change**
- [ ] New functionality (no existing behaviour affected)
- [ ] Replaces existing behaviour (describe what changes)
- [ ] Optional addition / toggle (client can opt in/out)

**Client Impact**
- Which clients would benefit?  (e.g. all, specific client, new clients only)
- Estimated player/user impact:

**Priority Suggestion**
- [ ] Critical – blocking a client launch or revenue
- [ ] High – significant improvement or compliance requirement
- [ ] Medium – quality-of-life improvement
- [ ] Low – nice to have

**Risks**
- What could go wrong if this feature misbehaves in production?
- Are there dependencies on payment processing, draw schedules, or third-party APIs?
- Could this break existing client configurations or player-facing behaviour?

**Rollback Procedure**
If the feature causes issues after release, how do we undo it?
- [ ] Feature flag — disable without redeployment
- [ ] Revert the release/commit (no data migration involved)
- [ ] Database migration rollback required (describe steps)
- [ ] Manual data correction needed
- [ ] Config change revert (admin toggle or setting)
- [ ] No rollback possible — must fix forward
- Notes:

**Additional Context**
Screenshots, mockups, Asana/Smartsheet links, or related issues.
